subject: maths
question: The average of three numbers A, B, and C is 48. The average of A and B is 45. The average of B and C is 49. What is the value of B?
solution:
The correct answer is __**44**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Value of middle term **B** = (Sum of A & B) + (Sum of B & C) − (Sum of A, B & C)

Sum of A & B = 45 × 2 = 90

Sum of B & C = 49 × 2 = 98

Sum of A, B & C = 48 × 3 = 144

∴ **B** = 90 + 98 − 144 = 188 − 144 = 44

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average of **A, B, and C** = 48

⇒ Average of **A and B** = 45

⇒ Average of **B and C** = 49

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9202d0dc6c4993cee70479b59255634086669ea8d4b44abe84664700bfbc8d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A + B + C = 48 × 3 = 144 --- (i)

⇒ A + B = 45 × 2 = 90 --- (ii)

⇒ B + C = 49 × 2 = 98 --- (iii)

⇒ Subtracting (ii) from (i): C = 144 − 90 = 54

⇒ Substituting C in (iii): B + 54 = 98

⇒ B = 98 − 54 = 44

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

Average is the central value of a set of data, calculated as Sum ÷ Count.

Net Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all observations from their mean is always zero.

Weighted Average

Combined average of two groups = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
